caption: The drawing depicts three views of a single ceramic object, which appears to be a mold or a bundt-style cake pan. The object is round and features a central cylindrical tube extending upwards from the base, creating a hole in the center. The exterior of the pan is decorated with repeating blue motifs resembling stylized floral or fleur-de-lis patterns set against a greyish or light brown background. The main, largest illustration is a perspective view showing both the side and interior of the pan, displaying the blue decorations evenly spaced along the outer perimeter. Above this view is a smaller side elevation of the pan, focusing on the outer design. At the bottom right, there is a top-down view depicting the circular opening and central tube. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, and the artist's name, Yolande DeLasser, is written in small letters at the lower left corner.
title: Baking Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
